RRA_Academy_Lecture.text: Rex Fleet Academy doctrine lecture hall — a tiered, human-scale classroom with a broad working floor rather than a ceremonial podium, shared projection surfaces, physical case files, and windows onto ordinary Academy traffic. It should feel like a place where officers, engineers, navigators, and civil administrators argue through practical problems.

RRA_Academy_ArchiveLab.text: Academy archive and simulation lab — darker than the lecture hall but still readable, with large historical playback surfaces, physical document tables, route-map projection space, and movable stations that let cadets reconstruct old decisions from incomplete records.

RRA_Prototype_Interior.text: Interior of the first multiworld post-Break rescue vessel launched from the Resolve Circle — visibly transitional, assembled from several engineering traditions, with mismatched consoles, patched conduit, physical route packets, field-repair access panels, and no polished mature-Fleet aesthetic.

RRA_Orison.text: Orison habitat — a once-efficient interdependent orbital settlement designed around frequent corridor resupply: elegant but increasingly cannibalized life-support systems, empty standardized parts racks, thinning food stores, dormant fabrication bays sized for replacement modules rather than raw local production, and residents still organized around arrival schedules that no longer mean anything.

RRA_Varda.text: Varda settlement — a post-Break community that survived by local manufacture, rationing, closed routing, and deliberate isolation: sturdy improvised machinery, locally standardized parts, food cultivation integrated into civic space, darkened external route receivers, and a physical boundary around the landing field that has not admitted an offworld ship in years.

RRA_Varda_Maintenance.text: Varda maintenance hall — crowded with locally fabricated components, hand-kept tolerance books, repaired machine tools, and equipment generations kept alive by skilled workers; resilient but increasingly separated from newer external measurements and route data.
